messages.subject: Secondary date axis
parts:
scale_x_continuous() now takes a sec.axis argument, but not so for scale_x_date() and scale_x_datetime().

Hadley recently closed https://github.com/tidyverse/ggplot2/issues/1936 because he doesn't have time to work on it, but he would review a PR. If somebody in the group knows how to implement it, would you submit a PR?
